Serve with chutney for dabbing.Continental hotel bar olivesWarm green olives with orange peel, rosemary and garlic, plus toasted almondsHow to make it300g green olives60ml extra virgin olive oil1 orange2 rosemary sprigs2 garlic cloves100g almondsWarm the olives in the oil with orange peel, rosemary and sliced garlic over low heat.Toast the almonds in a dry pan with a pinch of salt.Serve both in small bowls, the hotel bar way.Viggo's zakuski blini and herringViggo says John killed three men in a bar with a pencil.How to make itAs written, serves 4Warm blini with sour cream and salmon roe, buttered rye topped with pickled herring and red onion, and cold dill pickles alongside.Warm 16 blini at 180°C for 4 minutes and top each with a little sour cream, salmon roe and dill.Butter 4 slices dark rye, cut into fingers and top with 200g drained pickled herring and thinly sliced red onion.Halve 4 dill pickles lengthways.Lay everything out on a board and serve with ice-cold vodka for anyone who wants it.Beef carpaccio with horseradish creamAsk Charlie about a dinner reservation for twelve.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsCleaners' braised short ribsBeef short ribs braised 4 hours in red wine, served with the reduced sauceHow to make it2kg beef short ribs375ml red wine500ml beef stock4 garlic cloves1 bunch thyme200g polenta1 L water40g butter40g parmesanSeason and brown the short ribs in batches.Add the wine, stock, garlic and thyme. Cover and braise at 150°C until tender.Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until glossy, then return the ribs to coat.Cook the polenta in the water, stirring, then beat in the butter and parmesan.Spoon the ribs over the polenta.John's cast iron rib eyeThe quiet house before the troubleHow to make itAs written, serves 4Dry-brined rib eye seared in cast iron and basted with butter, garlic and rosemary, rested and sliced, with a sharp rocket, parmesan and lemon salad.Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 2 minutes a side, then add 50g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and rosemary and baste, turning, until 54°C inside.Rest 8 minutes and slice.Toss 2 bags rocket with shaved parmesan, lemon juice and olive oil.SweetsDaisy's puppy biscuitsPeanut butter shortbread bones, half dipped in dark chocolateHow to make it100g butter100g peanut butter80g icing sugar200g plain flour100g dark chocolateBeat the butter, peanut butter and icing sugar, then mix in the flour.Roll out and cut into small bone shapes.Bake at 170°C until firm.Cool, melt the chocolate and half dip each biscuit.
